ambiguity_policy: Record every multi-target structural candidate and stop acceptance if any are present; do not silently drop them.
candidate_definition: Member calls with one unique same-file visible using-library declaration matching method and argument-count+1; no receiver type or using-source filter; direct library receivers excluded.
equivalence: All prior resolved status/kind/target preserved; identifier and declared-array receiver using binding compared; approved wildcard discrepancies recorded separately.
numerator: status=resolved and exact target anchor equals independently selected candidate
outside_scope: Resolved library extension member calls, excluding direct library calls and ordinary internal calls.
